items.title: Eurozone annual inflation reaches 4% in October, according to Eurostat
items.summary: Eurostat flash estimates indicate euro area annual inflation rose to 4% in October 2026, marking its highest level in three years.

items.title: Lloyd’s consolidates oversight into single function to cut operating costs
items.summary: Lloyd’s of London is merging its market oversight activities into a single department led by Rachel Turk as part of a wider push to reduce operating complexity for managing agents.

items.title: Sheila Cameron to step down as chief executive of the Lloyd's Market Association
items.summary: Sheila Cameron is leaving her role as CEO of the Lloyd's Market Association in early 2027 after a seven-year tenure.

items.title: Society of Pension Practitioners reports rising demand for flexible retirement solutions
items.summary: Polling by the Society of Pension Practitioners shows a growing appetite among savers for retirement options that combine financial flexibility with increased security.

items.title: Luke Jensen appointed permanent Chair of National Savings and Investments
items.summary: HM Treasury has appointed Luke Jensen as the permanent Chair of the National Savings and Investments Board for a three-year term starting November 2026.

items.title: PIB Group recruits Aviva executive David Martin as group CEO
items.summary: PIB Group has appointed Aviva's David Martin as its incoming Group Chief Executive Officer, with the transition scheduled for early 2027.
